source.warning: Clusters are exploratory and mixed; labels below are manually consolidated into actionable support intents rather than copied directly from cluster IDs.

intents.name: Order status / tracking
intents.description: Customer wants to know where an order is, its current status, or tracking information.
examples_from_discovery: Nothing on my order on your web site.

intents.name: Delivery delay
intents.description: Expected delivery has passed or the shipment is repeatedly delayed without being delivered.
examples_from_discovery: Why it's me who should always follow up and not Amazon?
my regular subscribe and save shipment

intents.name: Delivery attempt / driver problem
intents.description: A delivery was missed, falsely marked attempted, left somewhere unexpected, or otherwise mishandled by the delivery service.
examples_from_discovery: there was no indication that they had re-attempted delivery
do you take any action when delivery boy falsely claims that he attempted delivery

intents.name: Payment / billing
intents.description: Payment failure, card issue, unexpected charge, or other checkout/billing problem.
examples_from_discovery: the card needs a day ... to activate

intents.name: Refund
intents.description: Customer asks about a refund, refund timing, or a refund that has not arrived.
examples_from_discovery: How much more time is required for refunding

intents.name: Return / replacement
intents.description: Customer needs help returning an item, replacing it, or resolving a return workflow problem.
examples_from_discovery: I'm getting the run around on a return.
when I try to return a book

intents.name: Order cancellation / change
intents.description: Customer wants to cancel, modify, or resolve a stuck/frozen order.
examples_from_discovery: response for the cancellation of the order
I have had an order frozen for a month

intents.name: Prime / subscription
intents.description: Questions or problems involving Prime membership, Prime Video, subscription charges, or cancellation.
examples_from_discovery: What is the point of Prime
Cancelación de membresía Amazon Prime y reembolso ya!

intents.name: Product / item issue
intents.description: Customer reports a damaged, defective, incorrectly packaged, missing, or otherwise problematic item.
examples_from_discovery: screen ... opened ... there was a crack

intents.name: Account / technical support
intents.description: Website, app, account, wishlist, login, or other technical/product-function problem not primarily about an order or payment.

fallback.name: Other / ambiguous
fallback.description: Use when the message does not clearly match one intent, is primarily a complaint with insufficient issue detail, is multilingual and cannot be reliably interpreted, or requires sensitive/manual handling.

labeling_rules: Label the customer's underlying issue, not the emotion or tone.
If multiple issues are present, choose the issue that requires the next support action; if no single issue is dominant, use other_ambiguous.
Delivery delay means the shipment is late; delivery_attempt_problem means the delivery event itself was mishandled or incorrectly recorded.
Refund is about money being returned; payment_billing is about paying, being charged, or payment failing.
Keep other_ambiguous available rather than forcing a low-confidence label.
